instruction: Write a Prometheus recording rule that precomputes the 5 minute request rate per job and name it job:http_requests:rate5m
output:
groups:
  - name: http-recording
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: job:http_requests:rate5m
        expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule computing the per-instance 1 minute request rate named instance:http_requests:rate1m
output:
groups:
  - name: http-recording
    rules:
      - record: instance:http_requests:rate1m
        expr: sum by (instance) (rate(http_requests_total[1m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:http_request_errors:rate5m for the 5xx error rate per job
output:
groups:
  - name: error-recording
    rules:
      - record: job:http_request_errors:rate5m
        expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:http_request_duration_seconds:p95 that caches the 95th percentile latency
output:
groups:
  - name: latency-recording
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: job:http_request_duration_seconds:p95
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))

instruction: Write a recording rule named instance:node_cpu_utilisation:rate5m for CPU utilisation excluding idle time
output:
groups:
  - name: node-recording
    rules:
      - record: instance:node_cpu_utilisation:rate5m
        expr: 1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named node:filesystem_usage:ratio for root filesystem usage between 0 and 1
output:
groups:
  - name: node-recording
    rules:
      - record: node:filesystem_usage:ratio
        expr: 1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"})

instruction: Write a recording rule named node:memory_utilisation:ratio computing used memory fraction
output:
groups:
  - name: node-recording
    rules:
      - record: node:memory_utilisation:ratio
        expr: 1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:up:ratio giving the fraction of healthy targets per job
output:
groups:
  - name: availability-recording
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: job:up:ratio
        expr: avg by (job) (up)

instruction: Write a recording rule named namespace:pod_count:count that counts pods per namespace
output:
groups:
  - name: kubernetes-recording
    rules:
      - record: namespace:pod_count:count
        expr: count by (namespace) (kube_pod_info)

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:http_requests:increase1h that caches one hour of request increase
output:
groups:
  - name: http-recording
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      - record: job:http_requests:increase1h
        expr: sum by (job) (increase(http_requests_total[1h]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named instance:network_receive:rate5m for receive bandwidth per instance
output:
groups:
  - name: node-recording
    rules:
      - record: instance:network_receive:rate5m
        expr: sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device!="lo"}[5m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:scrape_duration:avg5m averaging scrape duration per job
output:
groups:
  - name: scrape-recording
    rules:
      - record: job:scrape_duration:avg5m
        expr: avg by (job) (scrape_duration_seconds)

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:request_size:rate5m for bytes of request body received per second
output:
groups:
  - name: http-recording
    rules:
      - record: job:request_size:rate5m
        expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_request_size_bytes_sum[5m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named container:memory_working_set:ratio comparing usage to the memory limit
output:
groups:
  - name: container-recording
    rules:
      - record: container:memory_working_set:ratio
        expr: container_memory_working_set_bytes / container_spec_memory_limit_bytes

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:http_requests:irate1m using irate for a fast-moving counter
output:
groups:
  - name: http-recording
    rules:
      - record: job:http_requests:irate1m
        expr: sum by (job) (irate(http_requests_total[1m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named instance:process_cpu:rate5m for process CPU per second by instance

    rules:

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:probe_success:avg5m averaging blackbox probe success per job
output:
groups:

    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: job:probe_success:avg5m

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:http_requests_status:rate5m keeping the status label in the aggregation
output:
groups:
  - name: http-recording
    rules:
      - record: job:http_requests_status:rate5m
        expr: sum by (job, status) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:http_availability:ratio30d computing a 30 day success ratio
output:
groups:
  - name: slo-recording
    interval: 5m
    rules:
      - record: job:http_availability:ratio30d
        expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{status!~"5.."}[30d])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[30d]))

instruction: Write a recording rule named job:http_request_duration_seconds:p99 caching the 99th percentile per job
output:
groups:
  - name: latency-recording
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: job:http_request_duration_seconds:p99
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
